create_EasyAnimateControlPipeline: create an EasyAnimateControlPipeline for text-to-video generation with control video conditioning
run_EasyAnimateControlPipeline_call: run the EasyAnimateControlPipeline __call__ method to generate video from prompt and control inputs
build_preprocess_image: build a function to preprocess a single image by resizing and converting to normalized CHW tensor
build_get_video_to_video_latent: build a function to convert a list of video frames into latent tensors with optional mask and reference image
build_rescale_noise_cfg: build a function to rescale noise predictions to fix overexposure based on guidance rescale factor
